title: About Me
text:
I am Currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Applied Economics and Data Science at the University of Pennsylvania, with a solid background in economics and quantitative analytics.
My technical toolkit includes Python, R, Stata, SQL, C++, and Excel, which I apply to financial data processing and quantative analytics.
With hands-on experience spanning equity research, fraud risk detection, and operational risk management, I leverage data-driven strategies to solve real problems at the intersection of finance and technology.
I aspire to pursue roles such as Risk Analyst or Strategy Analyst in the future, where I can combine data analysis and financial knowledge to identify risks, evaluate opportunities, and drive better business and investment decisions.
